report.build: Cogan Kernel Builder run 38749819782 (#11), artifact build-6.1-KSUN+SUSFS-11, VARIANT KernelSU-Next+SuSFS+Test
report.device: POCO rothko (2407FPN8EG), MediaTek MT6989, HyperOS OS3.0.301.0.WNNIDXM, stock kernel 6.1.138-android14-11

panic.time: 1.625 s, PID 1 init (second stage), right after 'KernelSU: ksu_init_rc_hook is disabled'
panic.error: Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at virtual address 0000000000000000 (ESR 0x96000005)

root_cause.summary: ksu_cred was NULL when the SUSFS init.rc read hook ran load_module_rc_once() -> override_creds(ksu_cred)
chain: The pershoot KernelSU-Next fork (2f858cb) defaults CONFIG_KSU_SAMSUNG_KDP, CONFIG_KSU_SAMSUNG_RKP and CONFIG_KSU_SAMSUNG_DEFEX to y; olddefconfig kept them (resolved .config 41492e89...)
ksu_samsung_kdp_init() cannot resolve the Samsung-only symbol prepare_ro_creds on a non-Samsung GKI kernel and returns -ENOENT
kernelsu_init() returns before 'ksu_cred = prepare_creds()', so ksu_cred stays NULL (setup_ksu_cred() silently skips NULL)

The kernel-side SUSFS hooks are static keys in the kernel tree and stay enabled, so init's first read of /system/etc/init/hw/init.rc reaches ksu_install_rc_hook() -> load_module_rc_once() -> override_creds(NULL)
not_the_cause: Vendor modules loaded and boot reached second-stage init, so the 6.1.177 KMI was accepted
WARNINGs in xhci_mtk_trace_init/tracepoint_probe_unregister are a vendor driver registering one tracepoint probe twice (-EEXIST); non-fatal
Production 'KernelSU Next' builds use the official KernelSU-Next v3.4.2, whose Kconfig has no Samsung options
